goal: Open DocForge projects and present neutral document and desktop identity while preserving the approved workbench and Microsoft Word preview behavior.
test_paths: pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend lint && pnpm --dir frontend test && pnpm --dir frontend build
pnpm --dir frontend exec playwright test --config e2e/real-http.playwright.config.ts
cargo fmt --check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
non_goals: Do not redesign the three-pane layout or introduce a new screen.
Do not add dark mode, theme controls, i18n, or a locale switcher.
Do not accept bare Markdown or obsolete projects through UI fallbacks.
expected_evidence: Frontend typecheck, unit, browser, responsive, and accessibility output
Rust Tauri identity and command test output
Installed macOS project-open, diagnostics, build, and Word preview evidence
Task report, spec review, and quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Visible copy is only one part of desktop identity.
A local Web preview does not prove the installed Tauri package works.
Microsoft Word behavior must be checked directly because WPS is not the target.
stop_condition: Stop if the task requires a UI redesign, compatibility fallback, non-Office preview policy, or files outside this packet.
